title: Cops seize P900,000 smuggled cigarettes in Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – A businesswoman in Cotabato province and a pump boat operator in Sultan Kudarat province were separately arrested for trying to smuggle contraband cigarettes past law enforcers on Thursday, the Police Regional Office (PRO-12) said. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office (PRO-12) director, said that in Kabacan, Cotabato, a 27-year-old woman was arrested for possession of some P355,240 worth of allegedly smuggled cigarettes during a checkpoint operation at 1 p.m. in Barangay Kilagasan.
